Due to a permanent no-fly zone, a direct flight corridor between Station Alpha and Station Beta cannot be utilized.
Furthermore, due to conflicting air traffic control schedules, the inspection tour must incorporate exactly one of the following two essential flight segments: the corridor between Station Beta and Station Gamma, or the corridor between Station Gamma and Station Delta.

The objective is to determine the most efficient closed-loop flight itinerary, commencing and concluding at the same station, which visits every monitoring station precisely once.
